axes.blender_master: Z up, character faces -Y, character left = +X
axes.fbx: Y up, forward -Z (Blender exporter axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y)
axes.unreal_expected: Z up, mesh faces +Y (same as UE5 Mannequin / old Better Steve) -> keep the existing body yaw - 90 deg mesh offset (verify on first import)
axes.bone_axes: Blender bone axes kept (primary Y along the bone, secondary X); not Mannequin X-forward

SK_UnnamedPlayer_Head.note: separate material section: hide it for first person; the torso top face closes the neck

texture.filter: nearest/point recommended (pixel art); sRGB; no mip blur on the 64 px version

gaits.phase: 0 = left foot contact, 0.5 = right foot contact, shared by all 8 directions of a gait; walk and sprint compatible for phase blending; sneak has its own phase
gaits.seam: keys at frame 0 and frame N are identical; duration = N/60 s (no endpoint dwell)

air.sequence: Ground -> Jump_Start (on the jump tick; no anticipation delay) -> Jump_Rise (hold while vz > 0) -> Jump_Fall (loop while vz <= 0) -> Land_Soft / Land_Firm -> Ground. Edge falls skip Jump_Start.

landing_proposal.note: a jump on flat ground lands at ~8.9 m/s (game gravity 32 m/s^2), so soft is the everyday landing; a 2-block drop lands at ~11 m/s -> firm. Tuning proposal only.

air.rise_hold: Jump_Rise frames 12..18 are static: hold the last frame while still rising (jump boost, ledges).
air.interrupt: a new jump may start from any landing frame; landings never delay input (game-owned).

turn_controller_proposal.apply: presentation yaw = start_yaw + body_yaw_total * progress(t) on the SAME clock as the pose; root-neutral clips never rotate the root, so apply the yaw exactly once (mesh/body yaw only)
turn_controller_proposal.interrupt: movement input cross-fades into locomotion over 0.1-0.15 s; keep the yaw reached so far

look.convention: [yaw, pitch] degrees; yaw + = right, pitch + = UP
look.why_sneak_grid: standing grid applied as a mesh-space additive on the sneak pose pushes the head 8-10 cm into the torso looking up (s05); the sneak grid spreads more pitch into the spine

skeleton.name: SK_UnnamedPlayer_Skeleton (new; 22 bones)
skeleton.hand_style: box (vanilla arm box; the end block is the hand, bent by hand_l/r; the pickaxe handle passes through it)
skeleton.rest_pose: I-pose (arms down, palms in, thumbs forward); knees 1.2 cm forward, elbows 1.2 cm back of straight (IK bend hint)

sockets.name: SOCKET_hand_r_grip
sockets.note: pickaxe grip: tool +Y along the handle to the head, +Z toward the long point; SM_UP_Pickaxe origin/axes match, so attach with an identity relative transform

sockets.name: SOCKET_head_eye
sockets.note: painted-eye point on the head front face (debug)

socket_hand_r_pickaxe.tool_frame: +Y along the handle toward the head, +Z toward the long pick point, origin = grip centre

pickaxe.gameplay_timing: 0.30 s cycle = six 20 Hz steps; contact 0.15 s = frame 9 = step 3

support_grip.B: left hand on the handle 16 cm toward the head, frames ~2-14 (IK blend)

pickaxe.link_pose: frames 0 and 18 identical in A, B and C (chain any order: A->B->A->C)
